decision.reason: Restrict original COMPLETE to PARTIAL. Initial entry/state scope explicitly requires G1, whose frozen contract includes direct applicable URL navigation as well as reload. All original initial URLs are Labs and no direct-navigation action is retained; missing goto capability cannot waive the check. Actual plateau stop also reports PARTIAL loop. Retain completed narrow help/Close/Back and warm reload/history observations without asserting complete required coverage.

limit: Independent bounded coverage/claims reconciliation of all original retained cells and saved separate assessments; not an exhaustive code, product or security certification. Phase coverage is distinct from source/claim quality and narrow task passes. No winner, general benefit, efficiency, causal advantage, equal-scope comparability, live-revision identity or deployment/release readiness established. Native lifecycle/deadline/usage telemetry limits remain. Later corrections are separate evidence and do not rewrite original campaign results.
